data.title: Matter Explorer Adventure
data.description: Discover solids, liquids, and gases all around our everyday world!

objects.name: ice cube
objects.imagePrompt: A single clear ice cube sitting on a wooden kitchen table.

objects.name: water
objects.imagePrompt: A glass of fresh clear water on a sunny kitchen counter.

objects.name: air
objects.imagePrompt: A wide blue sky with gentle fluffy clouds on a bright sunny day.

objects.name: rock
objects.imagePrompt: A smooth gray river rock resting outdoors in green grass.

objects.name: milk
objects.imagePrompt: A glass cup filled with fresh white milk on a breakfast table.

objects.name: paper
objects.imagePrompt: A blank white sheet of writing paper on a school desk.

challenges.instruction: Say what happens when this melts on a warm day.
challenges.narration: I wonder what happens to the ice cube when the warm sun shines on it all afternoon?

challenges.instruction: Say what happens when this turns into ice in the freezer.
challenges.narration: I wonder what happens when we leave the water in the freezer overnight?

challenges.instruction: Say what happens to this when it is burned in a campfire.
challenges.narration: I wonder what happens to the paper if it gets too close to the camp fire flame?

challenges.instruction: Say what happens to this when it freezes in the coldest part of the fridge.
challenges.narration: I wonder what happens to the milk if it turns completely solid in the freezer?
